statements.status_notes: PingFederate processes JSON input using Jackson’s synchronous streaming parser (JsonFactory.createParser) and ObjectMapper APIs, both of which enforce StreamReadConstraints. The non-blocking parser path affected by GHSA-72hv-8253-57qq is not used anywhere in the codebase. Additionally, request bodies are wrapped with length-limiting input streams, providing further protection against large payload-based DoS conditions.
